skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply knowledge in customer management, human resource management, financial management, investment activities, and information system management in insurance companies.
Comprehend legal and technical requirements for financial and financial management, and investment management in insurance companies.
Analyze and evaluate business activities, market analysis, and insurance policies using business insurance knowledge.
Develop independent research, analytical, logical, and critical thinking skills, teamwork, presentation, and leadership skills.
Plan, coordinate, manage resources, evaluate, and improve the efficiency of activities.
Manage assets, capital, reserve funds, revenue, and expenses of insurance companies.
Manage human resources in insurance companies, including contracts, labor efficiency, and human resource functions.
Manage investment activities, principles, sources, factors, forms, organization, and evaluation of insurance companies.
Manage information systems in insurance companies, including concepts, roles, classifications, technical bases, and information management principles.
